questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Foundations.
questions.question: Which of the following are benefits of migrating to the AWS Cloud? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Migrating to AWS provides operational resilience (high availability, automated disaster recovery) and business agility (rapid innovation and provisioning).

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: A company is planning to replace its physical on-premises compute servers with AWS serverless compute services. The company wants to be able to take advantage of advanced technologies quickly after the migration. Which pillar of the AWS Well- Architected Framework does this plan represent?
questions.explanation: Taking advantage of advanced technologies quickly by democratizing complex infrastructure with managed/serverless services is a core principle of Performance Efficiency.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Networking.
questions.question: A company is planning to run a global marketing application in the AWS Cloud. The application will feature videos that can be viewed by users. The company must ensure that all users can view these videos with low latency. Which AWS service should the company use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: Amazon CloudFront is a global Content Delivery Network (CDN) that delivers video content with low latency using worldwide edge locations.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Foundations.
questions.question: Which component of the AWS global infrastructure is made up of one or more discrete redundant power, networking, and connectivity?
questions.explanation: An Availability Zone (AZ) consists of one or more discrete data centers with redundant power, networking, and connectivity in an AWS Region.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: Which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework refers to the ability of a system to recover from infrastructure or service disruptions and dynamically acquire computing resources to meet demand?
questions.explanation: The Reliability pillar focuses on recovering from infrastructure disruptions and dynamically allocating resources to meet demand.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: Who is responsible for configuration management under the AWS shared responsibility model?
options: It is solely the responsibility of the customer.
It is solely the responsibility of AWS.
It is shared between AWS and the customer.
It is not part of the AWS shared responsibility model.
questions.correctAnswer: It is shared between AWS and the customer.
correctAnswers: It is shared between AWS and the customer.
questions.explanation: Configuration management is a shared control: AWS maintains configuration of its infrastructure devices, while the customer configures their guest OS, network, and applications.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Compute.
questions.question: Which duties are the responsibility of a company that is using AWS Lambda? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: In AWS Lambda serverless execution, the customer is responsible for writing/updating the application code and securing code logic/dependencies.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Compute.
questions.question: Which compute hosting model should be accounted for in the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) when undertaking a cost analysis that allows physical isolation of a customer workload?
questions.explanation: Amazon EC2 Dedicated Hosts provide physical server isolation dedicated exclusively to a single customer workload, essential for compliance and licensing.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: Who is accountable for security and compliance under the AWS shared responsibility model?
options: AWS and the customer share responsibility.
AWS shares responsibility with the relevant governing body.
questions.correctAnswer: AWS and the customer share responsibility.
correctAnswers: AWS and the customer share responsibility.
questions.explanation: Under the AWS Shared Responsibility Model, security and compliance are shared duties between AWS (security OF the cloud) and the customer (security IN the cloud).

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: Which of the following is a critical design concept for architecting cloud applications?
questions.explanation: Implementing elasticity allows applications to dynamically scale compute capacity up or down based on traffic demand.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Compute.
questions.question: Which AWS services or features provide disaster recovery solutions for Amazon EC2 instances? (Choose two.)
options: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshots
correctAnswers: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshots
questions.explanation: Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) and Amazon EBS snapshots allow creating point-in-time image backups and disk copies to restore EC2 instances in disaster recovery scenarios.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Billing & Support.
questions.question: A company wants to review its monthly costs of using Amazon EC2 and Amazon RDS for the past year. Which AWS service or tool provides this information?
questions.explanation: AWS Cost Explorer lets users view, analyze, and forecast historical usage and spending for AWS services like EC2 and RDS over the past 12+ months.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Billing & Support.
questions.question: Who is the main point of contact for billing or account questions if a user has an AWS account with an Enterprise-level AWS Support plan?
questions.explanation: The AWS Concierge Support team is a senior customer service partner assigned exclusively to Enterprise Support plan customers for billing and account management.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Billing & Support.
questions.question: What is one technique to provide unified billing if each department within a firm has its own AWS account?
options: Use AWS Budgets on each account to pay only to budget.
Contact AWS Support for a monthly bill.
Create an AWS Organization from the payer account and invite the other accounts to join.
Put all invoices into one Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) bucket, load data into Amazon Redshift, and then run a billing report.
questions.correctAnswer: Create an AWS Organization from the payer account and invite the other accounts to join.
correctAnswers: Create an AWS Organization from the payer account and invite the other accounts to join.
questions.explanation: AWS Organizations consolidated billing enables linking multiple AWS department accounts to a single master management account with one unified monthly bill.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: Which cloud architecture design concept is supported by distributing workloads across various Availability Zones?
questions.explanation: Distributing workloads across multiple Availability Zones adheres to the "Design for failure" principle by ensuring redundant operation if one AZ fails.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: Which security-related duty is AWS accountable for under the AWS shared responsibility model?
questions.explanation: AWS is strictly responsible for the physical security, facilities, and underlying hardware across its global infrastructure.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Compute.
questions.question: A company wants to migrate a critical application to AWS. The application has a short runtime. The application is invoked by changes in data or by shifts in system state. The company needs a compute solution that maximizes operational efficiency and minimizes the cost of running the application. Which AWS solution should the company use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: AWS Lambda is an event-driven, serverless compute service that executes code in response to data/state changes with zero idle compute cost.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering DevOps & Automation.
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature allows users to connect with and deploy AWS services programmatically?
questions.explanation: AWS SDKs (Software Development Kits) provide programming language APIs to interact with and manage AWS services programmatically.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & IAM.
questions.question: According to the AWS shared responsibility model, who is responsible for managing IAM user access and secret keys?
options: IAM access and secret keys are static, so there is no need to rotate them.
The customer is responsible for rotating keys.
AWS will rotate the keys whenever required.
The AWS Support team will rotate keys when requested by the customer.
questions.correctAnswer: The customer is responsible for rotating keys.
correctAnswers: The customer is responsible for rotating keys.
questions.explanation: Customers are solely responsible for managing, rotating, and securing their IAM user credentials and secret access keys.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: To install a PCI-compliant workload on AWS, which of the following tasks is required?
options: Use any AWS service and implement PCI controls at the application layer
Use an AWS service that is in-scope for PCI compliance and raise an AWS support ticket to enable PCI compliance at the application layer
Use any AWS service and raise an AWS support ticket to enable PCI compliance on that service
Use an AWS service that is in scope for PCI compliance and apply PCI controls at the application layer
questions.correctAnswer: Use an AWS service that is in scope for PCI compliance and apply PCI controls at the application layer
correctAnswers: Use an AWS service that is in scope for PCI compliance and apply PCI controls at the application layer
questions.explanation: To run a PCI-compliant workload, customers must choose AWS services that are in-scope for PCI DSS and configure their application-level PCI security controls.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cost & Optimization.
questions.question: Which of the following is a suggestion made by an AWS Trusted Advisor? (Select two.)
questions.explanation: AWS Trusted Advisor inspects environments across 5 pillars: Cost Optimization, Performance, Security, Fault Tolerance, and Service Quotas.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Storage.
questions.question: A company plans to create a data lake that uses Amazon S3. Which factor will have the MOST effect on cost?
options: The selection of S3 storage tiers
Charges to transfer existing data into Amazon S3
The addition of S3 bucket policies
S3 ingest fees for each request
questions.correctAnswer: The selection of S3 storage tiers
correctAnswers: The selection of S3 storage tiers
questions.explanation: Selecting the appropriate S3 storage tier (e.g., S3 Standard, S3 Infrequent Access, S3 Glacier) has the largest impact on long-term data lake storage costs.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cost & Optimization.
questions.question: A company is launching an ecommerce application that must always be available. The application will run on Amazon EC2 instances continuously for the next 12 months. What is the MOST cost-effective instance purchasing option that meets these requirements?
questions.explanation: Savings Plans (or 1-year Standard Reserved Instances) offer significant cost savings (up to 72%) for continuous, steady-state compute workloads.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: Which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework is supported by the design philosophy of performing operations as code?
questions.explanation: Performing operations as code (Infrastructure as Code) is a cornerstone design principle of the Operational Excellence pillar.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: What is the customer's responsibility while using Amazon RDS?
options: Patching and maintenance of the underlying operating system.
Managing automatic backups of the database.
Controlling network access through security groups.
Replacing failed instances in the event of a hardware failure.
questions.correctAnswer: Controlling network access through security groups.
correctAnswers: Controlling network access through security groups.
questions.explanation: When using Amazon RDS managed database service, customers configure network access rules and firewall filtering using Security Groups.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: What is the customer's obligation while using an AWS managed service under the AWS shared responsibility model?
options: Physical security of the data centers
questions.explanation: For any AWS managed service, the customer always retains ownership and responsibility for customer data encryption and data protection.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Billing & Support.
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature can a company use to determine which business unit is using specific AWS resources?
questions.explanation: Cost allocation tags enable businesses to label and categorize AWS resources to allocate spending by department, cost center, or project.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Billing & Support.
questions.question: Which AWS service or tool should a company use to centrally request and track service limit increases?
questions.explanation: Service Quotas allows users to centrally view and request quota (limit) increases across all AWS services from one console.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: Which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework is designed on the idea of frequent, minor, reversible changes?
questions.explanation: The Operational Excellence pillar focuses on running systems, continual improvement, and learning from operational failures.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Monitoring.
questions.question: Which AWS service can identify the person who made the API request when an Amazon EC2 instance is terminated?
questions.explanation: AWS CloudTrail captures and records API calls, identifying the IAM user, IP address, and timestamp for all account events.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Billing & Support.
questions.question: All AWS users have access to which AWS Trusted Advisor check?
questions.explanation: All AWS accounts have access to core AWS Trusted Advisor checks (such as S3 bucket permissions, IAM root MFA, and specific service limits).

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: Which of the following is an example of security in the AWS Cloud under the AWS shared responsibility model?
questions.explanation: Firewall configuration (Security Groups and Network ACLs) is an example of Security IN the Cloud managed directly by the customer.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: Which documentation does AWS Artifact provide?
options: A history of a company's AWS spending
A list of previous-generation Amazon EC2 instance types
questions.explanation: AWS Artifact is the central portal for on-demand access to AWS compliance reports, SOC/PCI certifications, and security agreements.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & IAM.
questions.question: Which task requires using AWS account root user credentials?
options: Starting and stopping Amazon EC2 instances
questions.explanation: Changing or cancelling the AWS Support plan requires signing in with the root user credentials of the AWS account.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & IAM.
questions.question: Permissions for which of the following are managed by service control policies (SCPs)?
questions.explanation: Service Control Policies (SCPs) define and enforce maximum permission boundaries across member accounts in AWS Organizations.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Monitoring.
questions.question: Which of the following AWS services should a client utilize to audit the change management of AWS resources?
questions.explanation: AWS Config continually monitors, evaluates, and audits configuration changes and compliance history of AWS resources.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: What is raised when a business deploys web servers across several AWS Regions?
questions.explanation: Deploying web servers across multiple AWS Regions enhances high availability and disaster resilience against regional disruptions.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: Which of the following is a shared control between a client and AWS under the shared responsibility model?
questions.explanation: Patch management is a shared control: AWS patches host hardware and managed services, while customers patch EC2 guest operating systems.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Networking.
questions.question: What is the scope of a VPC within the AWS network?
options: A VPC can span all Availability Zones globally.
A VPC must span at least two subnets in each AWS Region.
A VPC must span at least two edge locations in each AWS Region.
A VPC can span all Availability Zones within an AWS Region.
questions.correctAnswer: A VPC can span all Availability Zones within an AWS Region.
correctAnswers: A VPC can span all Availability Zones within an AWS Region.
questions.explanation: An Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) spans all Availability Zones within a single designated AWS Region.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Networking.
questions.question: Which of the following are components of an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: An AWS Site-to-Site VPN connects an on-premises network via a Customer Gateway to an AWS Virtual Private Gateway (or Transit Gateway).

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & IAM.
questions.question: According to the AWS shared responsibility model, which job is shared between AWS and the customer?
questions.explanation: Applying Least Privilege means granting users only the minimum necessary permissions required to execute their specific job tasks.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: How should an application be created to function on the AWS Cloud in accordance with best practices?
questions.explanation: Decoupling components into loosely coupled microservices prevents cascading system failures and allows independent scaling.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: Which cloud architectural concept is supported by a system that can scale in terms of users, traffic, or data quantity without sacrificing performance?
questions.explanation: A system that automatically scales capacity in response to real-time workload fluctuations demonstrates cloud elasticity.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: The following describes an application that spans various Availability Zones:
questions.explanation: Running an application across multiple Availability Zones provides high availability with automatic failover and redundancy.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Networking.
questions.question: A company needs to establish a connection between two VPCs. The VPCs are located in two different AWS Regions. The company wants to use the existing infrastructure of the VPCs for this connection. Which AWS service or feature can be used to establish this connection?
questions.explanation: VPC peering establishes a direct network route between two VPCs (even across AWS Regions) using private IP addressing.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Databases.
questions.question: According to the AWS shared responsibility model, what responsibility does a customer have when using Amazon RDS to host a database?
questions.explanation: With Amazon RDS, the customer manages database user credentials, connections, queries, and data schemas.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Compute.
questions.question: Which duty is the customer's responsibility while administering AWS Lambda functions under the AWS shared responsibility model?
options: Scaling Lambda resources according to demand
questions.explanation: When using AWS Lambda, customers are responsible for managing function versions, aliases, code packages, and IAM execution roles.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: Which of the following is not a duty of the client under the AWS shared responsibility model? (Select two.)
options: Patch management of an Amazon RDS instance operating system
Controlling physical access to data centers
Patch management of an Amazon EC2 instance operating system
correctAnswers: Controlling physical access to data centers
questions.explanation: Decommissioning physical disks and physical access control to data centers are strict responsibilities of AWS, not the customer.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Billing & Support.
questions.question: Which service or functionality does AWS Enterprise Support provide that other AWS Support subscriptions do not?
questions.explanation: AWS Enterprise Support provides a dedicated Concierge team for white-glove billing assistance and account operational support.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cost & Optimization.
questions.question: What attributes of an AWS account can AWS Trusted Advisor monitor and advise on? (Select two.)
questions.explanation: AWS Trusted Advisor provides real-time guidance across Cost Optimization, Security, Fault Tolerance, Performance, and Service Quotas.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Compute.
questions.question: Which feature enables Amazon EC2 instances to be more elastic in response to changing workload demand?
questions.explanation: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling automatically adds or terminates EC2 instances according to demand conditions and scaling policies.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Networking.
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature acts as a firewall for Amazon EC2 instances?
questions.explanation: A Security Group functions as a virtual stateful firewall controlling inbound and outbound traffic at the EC2 instance level.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: Which feature enables Amazon EC2 instances to be more elastic in response to changing workload demand?
questions.explanation: Customer-managed encryption (e.g. KMS customer-managed keys) provides customer control over data encryption options.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Billing & Support.
questions.question: What is the unique advantage that Enterprise Support customers receive?
options: Access to a Technical Project Manager
Access to a Technical Account Manager
Access to a Cloud Support Engineer
questions.correctAnswer: Access to a Technical Account Manager
correctAnswers: Access to a Technical Account Manager
questions.explanation: Enterprise Support includes a designated Technical Account Manager (TAM) who provides proactive technical guidance and architecture reviews.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Foundations.
questions.question: What are the advantages of AWS Cloud elasticity?
options: Ensure web traffic is automatically spread across multiple AWS Regions.
Minimize storage costs by automatically archiving log data.
Enable AWS to automatically select the most cost-effective services.
Automatically adjust the required compute capacity to maintain consistent performance.
questions.correctAnswer: Automatically adjust the required compute capacity to maintain consistent performance.
correctAnswers: Automatically adjust the required compute capacity to maintain consistent performance.
questions.explanation: Elasticity allows an infrastructure to automatically adjust compute capacity to maintain steady performance as load fluctuates.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cost & Optimization.
questions.question: Which cost components should be addressed when developing a cloud Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) model for AWS workloads? (Select three.)
questions.explanation: In AWS cloud TCO, primary recurring operational costs include Compute, Storage, and outbound Data Transfer.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Billing & Support.
questions.question: Which of the following are capabilities of the AWS Cost Management tools? (Select two.)
options: Terminate all AWS resources automatically if budget thresholds are exceeded.
Break down AWS costs by day, service, and linked AWS account.
Create budgets and receive notifications if current or forecasted usage exceeds the budgets.
Switch automatically to Reserved Instances or Spot Instances, whichever is most cost-effective.
Move data stored in Amazon S3 to a more cost-effective storage class.
questions.correctAnswer: Break down AWS costs by day, service, and linked AWS account.
correctAnswers: Break down AWS costs by day, service, and linked AWS account.
Create budgets and receive notifications if current or forecasted usage exceeds the budgets.
questions.explanation: AWS Cost Management tools allow creating budgets with threshold alerts and breaking down spending by day, service, and linked account.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & IAM.
questions.question: How should an Amazon EC2 instance be granted access to an Amazon S3 bucket in accordance with security best practices?
options: Hard code an IAM user's secret key and access key directly in the application, and upload the file
Store the IAM user's secret key and access key in a text file on the EC2 instance, read the keys, then upload the file.
Have the EC2 instance assume a role to obtain the privileges to upload the file.
Modify the S3 bucket policy so that any service can upload to it at any time.
questions.correctAnswer: Have the EC2 instance assume a role to obtain the privileges to upload the file.
correctAnswers: Have the EC2 instance assume a role to obtain the privileges to upload the file.
questions.explanation: Attaching an IAM Role to an Amazon EC2 instance provides secure temporary credentials without hardcoding secret access keys.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: A company has a single Amazon EC2 instance. The company wants to adopt a highly available architecture. What can the company do to meet this requirement?
options: Scale vertically to a larger EC2 instance size.
Scale horizontally across multiple Availability Zones.
Change the EC2 instance family to a compute optimized instance.
questions.correctAnswer: Scale horizontally across multiple Availability Zones.
correctAnswers: Scale horizontally across multiple Availability Zones.
questions.explanation: Scaling horizontally across multiple Availability Zones provides high availability and fault resilience against single-instance failures.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Foundations.
questions.question: A company's on-premises application deployment cycle was 3–4 weeks. After migrating to the AWS Cloud, the company can deploy the application in 2–3 days. Which benefit has this company experienced by moving to the AWS Cloud?
questions.explanation: Agility is the speed and ease with which teams can innovate, build, test, and deploy software in the cloud.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cost & Optimization.
questions.question: Which of the following price options would result in the highest reduction after making an Amazon EC2 Dedicated Host reservation?
questions.explanation: The "All Upfront" payment option for Reserved Instances offers the maximum percentage discount over on-demand rates.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: Which AWS services and/or features increase availability and mitigate the effect of failures while constructing a typical three-tier web application? (Select two.)
options: AWS Auto Scaling for Amazon EC2 instances
Amazon VPC subnet ACLs to check the health of a service
Distributed resources across multiple Availability Zones
AWS Server Migration Service (AWS SMS) to move Amazon EC2 instances into a different Region
Distributed resources across multiple AWS points of presence
questions.correctAnswer: AWS Auto Scaling for Amazon EC2 instances
correctAnswers: AWS Auto Scaling for Amazon EC2 instances
Distributed resources across multiple Availability Zones
questions.explanation: Distributing resources across multiple AZs and using Auto Scaling mitigates hardware failures and ensures continuous service availability.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Foundations.
questions.question: Which of the following IT responsibilities may AWS relieve a company's IT team of? (Select two.)
options: Setting up access controls for data
questions.explanation: Managed services relieve internal IT teams of database software patching and physical storage capacity planning.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: Which of the following is included in the AWS Trusted Advisor checks? (Select two.)
options: Information on Amazon S3 bucket permissions
Multi-factor authentication enabled on the AWS account root user
Number of users in the account
questions.correctAnswer: Information on Amazon S3 bucket permissions
correctAnswers: Information on Amazon S3 bucket permissions
Multi-factor authentication enabled on the AWS account root user
questions.explanation: Core Trusted Advisor checks inspect S3 bucket open access permissions and verify root account Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: What is AWS accountable for under the AWS shared responsibility model?
questions.explanation: AWS manages the physical hardware, hypervisors, and global network infrastructure under the shared responsibility model.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cost & Optimization.
questions.question: Which of the following tasks may be used to improve Amazon EC2 costs? (Select two.)
options: Implementing Auto Scaling groups to add and remove instances based on demand.
Creating a policy to restrict IAM users from creating new instances.
Setting a budget to limit spending on EC2 instances using AWS Budgets.
Adding EC2 instances to a second AWS Region that is geographically close to the end users.
questions.correctAnswer: Implementing Auto Scaling groups to add and remove instances based on demand.
correctAnswers: Implementing Auto Scaling groups to add and remove instances based on demand.
questions.explanation: Using EC2 Auto Scaling to right-size capacity dynamically and purchasing Reserved Instances for steady workloads optimizes EC2 costs.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Billing & Support.
questions.question: Which of the following are included in AWS Enterprise Support? (Choose two.)
options: Support of third-party software integration to AWS
questions.explanation: Enterprise Support provides a dedicated TAM and a 15-minute response SLA for business-critical system outages.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering DevOps & Automation.
questions.question: A company wants to limit its employees' AWS access to a portfolio of predefined AWS resources. Which AWS solution should the company use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: AWS Service Catalog allows organizations to create, govern, and distribute approved portfolios of IT services and templates.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: Which of the following is a customer duty under the AWS shared responsibility model?
options: Installing security patches for the Xen and KVM hypervisors
Installing operating system patches for Amazon DynamoDB
Installing operating system security patches for Amazon EC2 database instances
Installing operating system security patches for Amazon RDS database instances
questions.correctAnswer: Installing operating system security patches for Amazon EC2 database instances
correctAnswers: Installing operating system security patches for Amazon EC2 database instances
questions.explanation: On Amazon EC2 instances (IaaS), the customer is responsible for guest OS security patching and software updates.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: A firm wishes to develop a new line of business application. Which design concepts should be applied in accordance with the AWS Well- Architected Framework? (Select two.)
options: Consolidate multiple AWS accounts into a single account.
Buy and host hardware in the AWS Cloud.
Decouple the AWS Cloud architecture to break up monolithic deployments.

AWS manages user applications in the AWS Cloud

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cost & Optimization.

Maintain least privilege access to the root user account

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cost & Optimization.
questions.question: A company has designed its AWS Cloud infrastructure to run its workloads effectively. The company also has protocols in place to continuously improve supporting processes. Which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework does this scenario represent?

The maximum amount of RAM an Amazon EC2 instance can use
How easily resources can be produced when they are needed

correctAnswers: The ability to right-size resources as demand shifts
How easily resources can be produced when they are needed

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Billing & Support.

Proceed with creating a new dashboard in Amazon QuickSight

correctAnswers: Open a detailed case related to billing and submit it to AWS Support for help

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & IAM.

Provide only the permissions that are needed for users to do their jobs in the current month
Assign permissions that are based on job titles

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.

Physical security of data center facilities

correctAnswers: Setting up server-side encryption on an Amazon S3 bucket

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Billing & Support.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Billing & Support.
questions.question: A company wants to run production workloads on AWS. The company needs concierge service, a designated AWS technical account manager (TAM), and technical support that is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Which AWS Support plan will meet these requirements?

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: Which of the following tasks is the AWS customer’s duty under the shared responsibility model? (Select two.)

Ensuring that users have received security training in the use of AWS services

correctAnswers: Ensuring that application data is encrypted at rest

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: Before transferring an environment to the AWS Cloud, a cloud practitioner must receive AWS compliance reports. How are these reports produced?

Open a case with AWS Support
Generate the reports with Amazon Macie

correctAnswers: Download the reports from AWS Artifact

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & IAM.

Maintaining environmental controls within a data center

Patching the operating system on an Amazon EC2 instance

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cost & Optimization.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & IAM.
questions.question: Which of the following may be used to restrict certain users’ access to Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) buckets?
options: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: Which of the following is an AWS Well-Architected Framework design principle?
options: Reduce downtime by making infrastructure changes infrequently and in large increments.
Invest the time to configure infrastructure manually.
Learn to improve from operational failures.
Use monolithic application design for centralization.
questions.correctAnswer: Learn to improve from operational failures.
correctAnswers: Learn to improve from operational failures.
questions.explanation: Learning from operational failures and conducting root-cause post-mortems is a core design principle of the Operational Excellence pillar.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Networking.
questions.question: Which AWS service enables a business to identify and reroute customers to other servers in the event of a website server outage?

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Billing & Support.

options: AWS Support using a support case
questions.correctAnswer: AWS Support using a support case
correctAnswers: AWS Support using a support case

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering DevOps & Automation.
questions.question: Which AWS service enables you to monitor and debug distributed applications end-to- end?

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: Which AWS shared responsibility model duties are the customer’s responsibility? (Select two.)

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cost & Optimization.
questions.question: Which AWS Cloud service gives tips on how to optimize an AWS account’s performance?
questions.explanation: AWS Trusted Advisor inspects your AWS environment and provides actionable recommendations to optimize performance, security, and cost.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cost & Optimization.

The number of configured Amazon S3 buckets
Compute resources that are currently in use

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Monitoring.
questions.question: A corporation is required by law to track and assess configuration changes to AWS resources, as well as to conduct corrective steps. Which Amazon Web Services (AWS) service should the business use?
questions.explanation: AWS Config continually records, evaluates, and audits configuration changes of AWS resources to satisfy compliance and governance mandates.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Storage.
questions.question: Which AWS service should be utilized to store data backups for an extended period of time at a reasonable cost?

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Foundations.
questions.question: What does the AWS Cloud bring clients in terms of increased execution speed and agility? (Select two.)
options: Readily available resources with low provisioning times
questions.correctAnswer: Readily available resources with low provisioning times
correctAnswers: Readily available resources with low provisioning times
questions.explanation: The cloud delivers rapid execution speed and business agility through on-demand resource provisioning in minutes and scalable compute capacity.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: A retailer wishes to supply just the resources required to meet current demand. Which cloud advantage is the organization attempting to accomplish with this objective?
questions.explanation: Scalability is the ability of a system to increase or decrease computing capacity in accordance with current workload demands.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Storage.
questions.question: What storage capabilities does Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering provide?

Long-term retention of data by copying the data to an encrypted Amazon EBS volume
Automatic cost savings by moving objects between tiers based on access pattern changes
Secure, durable, and lowest-cost storage for data archival

correctAnswers: Automatic cost savings by moving objects between tiers based on access pattern changes

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Networking.

Build a VPN connection between an on-premises device and a virtual private gateway in the new VPC
Use Amazon Athena to query data from on-premises database servers
Connect the company’s on-premises data center to AWS using AWS Direct Connect
Leverage Amazon CloudFront to restrict access to static web content hosted on- premises
questions.correctAnswer: Build a VPN connection between an on-premises device and a virtual private gateway in the new VPC
correctAnswers: Build a VPN connection between an on-premises device and a virtual private gateway in the new VPC
Connect the company’s on-premises data center to AWS using AWS Direct Connect
questions.explanation: Establishing an AWS Site-to-Site VPN or AWS Direct Connect dedicated link allows secure hybrid communication between on-premises and AWS VPC resources.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Networking.
questions.question: What is the most effective approach to link an on-premises network to numerous VPCs located in separate AWS Regions?
questions.explanation: AWS Transit Gateway simplifies network architecture by acting as a centralized hub connecting multiple VPCs and on-premises networks.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Foundations.
questions.question: Multiple Regions of the AWS Cloud are an example of:

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering DevOps & Automation.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Foundations.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: SQL injection attacks are being launched against an application from a variety of external locations. Which AWS service or functionality can assist in automating response to these attacks?
questions.explanation: AWS WAF (Web Application Firewall) protects web applications from common web exploits like SQL injection and cross-site scripting (XSS).

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Compute.
questions.question: Which feature enables Amazon EC2 instances to be more elastic in response to changing workload demand?
questions.explanation: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling dynamically adjusts the number of EC2 instances to maintain performance and ensure elasticity.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Compute.
questions.question: What time-saving benefits can Amazon Rekognition provide?

Ability to resize millions of images automatically
Use of Amazon Mechanical Turk for human-powered object detection jobs
questions.correctAnswer: Automatic detection of objects appearing in pictures
correctAnswers: Automatic detection of objects appearing in pictures
questions.explanation: Amazon Rekognition uses deep learning to automatically detect objects, scenes, text, and faces in images and video streams.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Storage.
questions.question: A corporation wants to migrate petabytes of data from on-premises sites to the AWS Cloud as rapidly as feasible. Which Amazon Web Services (AWS) service should the business use?

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Foundations.
questions.question: Where should a business go to locate, test, purchase, and deploy software that works on AWS?

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.

questions.explanation: A Multi-Region active-active architecture serves traffic from multiple regions concurrently, providing maximum availability and lowest latency worldwide.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: Which duty is the customer’s responsibility under the AWS shared responsibility model?
options: Maintaining the infrastructure needed to run AWS Lambda
Updating the operating system of Amazon DynamoDB instances
Updating the guest operating system on Amazon EC2 instances
questions.correctAnswer: Updating the guest operating system on Amazon EC2 instances
correctAnswers: Updating the guest operating system on Amazon EC2 instances
questions.explanation: When running Amazon EC2 instances, the customer is fully responsible for maintaining and updating the guest operating system.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: How can a user safeguard against AWS service outages in the event of a widespread natural disaster?
options: Deploy applications across multiple Availability Zones within an AWS Region
Use a hybrid cloud computing deployment model within the geographic area
Deploy applications across multiple AWS Regions
Store application artifacts using AWS Artifact and replicate them across multiple AWS Regions
questions.correctAnswer: Deploy applications across multiple AWS Regions
correctAnswers: Deploy applications across multiple AWS Regions
questions.explanation: Deploying applications across multiple geographically distinct AWS Regions protects workloads from wide-scale regional natural disasters or disruptions.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: What is an example of a cloud-based application that is decoupled and scalable?
options: A mail and log application that runs on a single Amazon EC2 instance
A webpage hosted on Amazon S3 and using AWS Lambda to update an Amazon DynamoDB database
An Application Load Balancer, web server, and database server supporting a monolithic application
A legacy database server running on the maximum instance size supported by its license
questions.correctAnswer: A webpage hosted on Amazon S3 and using AWS Lambda to update an Amazon DynamoDB database
correctAnswers: A webpage hosted on Amazon S3 and using AWS Lambda to update an Amazon DynamoDB database
questions.explanation: A serverless architecture combining static S3 hosting, event-driven AWS Lambda compute, and Amazon DynamoDB is decoupled, scalable, and highly available.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Billing & Support.
questions.question: A client has many AWS accounts, each with its own billing. How can the client benefit from bulk savings while minimizing the effect on AWS resources?
options: Create one global AWS account and move all AWS resources to that account
Sign up for three years of Reserved Instance pricing up front
Use the consolidated billing feature from AWS Organizations
Sign up for the AWS Enterprise Support plan to get volume discounts
questions.correctAnswer: Use the consolidated billing feature from AWS Organizations
correctAnswers: Use the consolidated billing feature from AWS Organizations
questions.explanation: Using Consolidated Billing in AWS Organizations combines all linked accounts into a single bill and shares volume discounts.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Foundations.
questions.question: A business must keep its data near to its core consumers. Which AWS Cloud advantage satisfies this requirement?
questions.explanation: AWS global footprint enables deploying applications and data in multiple regions close to international end users.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: Who is responsible for the virtualization layer down to the physical security of the facilities in which AWS services operate under the AWS shared responsibility model?
options: It is the sole responsibility of the customer.
It is the sole responsibility of AWS.
It is a shared responsibility between AWS and the customer.
The customer's AWS Support plan tier determines who manages the configuration.
questions.correctAnswer: It is the sole responsibility of AWS.
correctAnswers: It is the sole responsibility of AWS.
questions.explanation: Under the Shared Responsibility Model, AWS is solely responsible for physical facilities, data center hardware, and the virtualization hypervisor layer.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & IAM.
questions.question: A company's managed IAM policy does not allow users the rights essential to do needed activities. How is this situation to be resolved?
options: Use a third-party web application firewall (WAF) managed rule from the AWS Marketplace
Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to create a customer-managed key
questions.explanation: When AWS-managed policies do not match exact business requirements, administrators create customer-managed IAM policies.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & IAM.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Compute.

A company has a number of application services whose SLA requires 99.999% uptime.
A company's heavily used legacy database is currently running on-premises.
A company has a number of infrequent, interruptible jobs that are currently using On-Demand Instances.
questions.correctAnswer: A company has a number of infrequent, interruptible jobs that are currently using On-Demand Instances.
correctAnswers: A company has a number of infrequent, interruptible jobs that are currently using On-Demand Instances.
questions.explanation: Amazon EC2 Spot Instances offer steep discounts (up to 90%) for stateless, fault-tolerant, and interruptible workloads.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Networking.
questions.question: A business must transmit time-sensitive communications to a large number of subscribers using a push technique. Which Amazon Web Services (AWS) service should the business use?

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & IAM.

options: Modifying an Amazon EC2 instance type
Grouping resources in AWS Systems Manager
Running applications in Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: Which AWS Cloud best practice makes advantage of cloud computing's flexibility and agility?
options: Provision capacity based on past usage and theoretical peaks
Dynamically and predictively scale to meet usage demands
Build the application and infrastructure in a data center that grants physical access
Break apart the application into loosely coupled components
questions.correctAnswer: Dynamically and predictively scale to meet usage demands
correctAnswers: Dynamically and predictively scale to meet usage demands

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Networking.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & IAM.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Foundations.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Databases.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Billing & Support.

correctAnswers: Scaling the number of Amazon EC2 instances based on traffic
