questions.explanation: All Upfront Reserved Instances provide the highest percentage discount over On-Demand rates for steady-state workloads.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Compute.
questions.question: A company is migrating to Amazon S3. The company needs to transfer 60 TB of data from an on-premises data center to AWS within 10 days. Which AWS service should the company use to accomplish this migration?
questions.explanation: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling automatically adds or removes EC2 instances to dynamically match fluctuating demand.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Foundations.
questions.question: What type of database is Amazon DynamoDB?
questions.explanation: Elasticity allows automatically scaling computing resources up or down in real time to match changing business demands.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Storage.
questions.question: A retail company has recently migrated its website to AWS. The company wants to ensure that it is protected from SQL injection attacks. Which AWS service or feature can be used to create a custom rule that blocks SQL injection attacks?
questions.explanation: Amazon EBS (Elastic Block Store) provides persistent, high-performance block-level storage volumes for Amazon EC2 instances.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Billing & Support.
questions.question: Which AWS services enable users to link their AWS Cloud resources to their on- premises resources? (Select two.)
questions.explanation: Consolidated billing in AWS Organizations aggregates usage across all member accounts into a single monthly invoice.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Monitoring.
questions.question: While an Amazon EC2 instance is only activated when it is required, it must stay active throughout the life of the procedure. What is the most acceptable method of purchase?
questions.explanation: AWS CloudTrail captures all management console and API actions into audit logs, recording who made each request and when.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Storage.
questions.question: A business's operations are conducted on-site. The business wants to anticipate the costs associated with hosting a major application on AWS. Which AWS service or tool does the business have access to in order to collect this information?
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval (and Deep Archive) offers low-cost, durable cold storage designed for compliance archiving.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: How can a client strengthen the security of their Amazon Web Services (AWS) account logins? (Select two.)
options: Use Amazon Cognito to manage access
questions.explanation: Configuring IAM user permissions and patching guest operating systems on EC2 are customer responsibilities under the Shared Responsibility Model.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: A big firm often has a single Amazon Web Services (AWS) account. What are the benefits of repurposing a single AWS account to create additional AWS accounts? (Select two.)
options: It allows for administrative isolation between different workloads.
Discounts can be applied on a quarterly basis by submitting cases in the AWS Management Console.
Transitioning objects from Amazon S3 to Amazon S3 Glacier in separate AWS accounts will be less expensive.
Having multiple accounts reduces the risks associated with malicious activity targeted at a single account.
Amazon QuickSight offers access to a cost tool that provides application-specific recommendations for environments running in multiple accounts.
questions.correctAnswer: It allows for administrative isolation between different workloads.
correctAnswers: It allows for administrative isolation between different workloads.
questions.explanation: AWS Shield is a managed DDoS protection service safeguarding web applications on AWS from network and transport layer attacks.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: Which solution enables a business with numerous AWS accounts to consolidate its consumption in order to qualify for bulk discounts?
questions.explanation: AWS is responsible for physical and environmental security of the facilities housing AWS infrastructure.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cost & Optimization.
questions.question: Which AWS services may be protected against typical online exploitations using AWS WAF? (Select two.)
questions.explanation: Consolidated billing combines usage across all linked accounts to share volume tier discounts and simplifies accounting with one bill.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: A business uses an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling policy in conjunction with an Application Load Balancer to restore sick apps running on Amazon EC2 instances automatically. This activity pertains to which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework?
questions.explanation: The Reliability pillar focuses on workloads performing correctly and consistently, with automated recovery from component disruptions.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Compute.
questions.question: A business wants to migrate current software licenses to AWS, however the licensing strategy involves licensing physical cores. How can the organization do this in the AWS Cloud?
options: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance with default tenancy.
Launch an Amazon EC2 instance on a Dedicated Host.
questions.correctAnswer: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance on a Dedicated Host.
correctAnswers: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance on a Dedicated Host.
questions.explanation: Amazon EC2 Dedicated Hosts give physical server visibility and core socket control, satisfying per-socket and per-core software licensing requirements.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Storage.
questions.question: Which service offers nearly infinite online storage for very durable objects?
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 provides highly durable (11 9s), virtually unlimited object storage for internet-accessible files and data lakes.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Foundations.
questions.question: Which of the following is an advantage that users experience when they move on- premises workloads to the AWS Cloud?
options: Elimination of expenses for running and maintaining data centers
Price discounts that are identical to discounts from hardware providers
Distribution of all operational controls to AWS
questions.correctAnswer: Elimination of expenses for running and maintaining data centers
correctAnswers: Elimination of expenses for running and maintaining data centers
questions.explanation: Moving to AWS eliminates capital expenditures and recurring maintenance overhead associated with managing physical data center facilities.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Storage.
questions.question: Which AWS services are available for file storage? (Select two.)
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 (with S3 File Gateway) and AWS Storage Gateway provide scalable file storage solutions accessible across networks.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Networking.
questions.question: A media business wants to disseminate video material through the internet to millions of viewers globally. The organization wishes to use AWS's worldwide network backbone in order to deliver cached material with minimal latency and fast data transfer rates. Which AWS service will satisfy these criteria?
questions.explanation: Amazon CloudFront distributes video and streaming content with low latency using its worldwide network of edge location points of presence.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Foundations.
questions.question: Which AWS advantage allows customers to construct cloud infrastructure that spans various geographic areas and is linked through a low-latency, high-performance network?
questions.explanation: AWS Global Infrastructure allows businesses to deploy applications worldwide in minutes to serve international customers with low latency.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Billing & Support.
questions.question: Which AWS service or feature enables businesses to take advantage of AWS's volume discounts?
questions.explanation: AWS Organizations enables consolidated billing to aggregate usage across accounts and achieve higher volume discount tiers.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & IAM.
questions.question: Which AWS IAM feature is used to link numerous users with a set of permissions?
questions.explanation: IAM Groups allow administrators to attach permission policies to a collection of users simultaneously, streamlining access management.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Databases.
questions.question: A social media firm has been tasked with the responsibility of launching a new function. Users will be able to share photographs that will be seen by other users worldwide with little delay. Which AWS service or feature should the business use in order to achieve this demand the most cost-effectively?
questions.explanation: Amazon DynamoDB Global Tables provide fully managed, multi-region active-active database replication for globally distributed applications.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: Which AWS service enables application decoupling?
questions.explanation: Amazon SQS (Simple Queue Service) decouples application components, allowing microservices to communicate asynchronously.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: Amazon EC2 web servers connect to a traditional application operating in a corporate data center. What phrase would be appropriate to use to describe this model?
questions.explanation: A hybrid cloud architecture connects on-premises legacy systems with cloud-hosted compute and storage resources.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: Which design principle is included in the operational excellence pillar of the AWS Well- Architected Framework?
questions.explanation: Anticipating failure and performing operations as code are foundational principles of the Operational Excellence pillar.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Compute.
questions.question: Which of the following is the customer responsible for updating and patching, according to the AWS shared responsibility model?
options: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server
AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory
Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server
questions.explanation: In Amazon WorkSpaces (virtual desktop service), the customer is responsible for managing, updating, and patching the Windows OS and user applications.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Monitoring.
questions.question: A previously utilized Amazon EC2 instance for development is no longer available and does not display in the AWS Management Console. Which AWS service should be utilized to discover what activity resulted in the inaccessibility of this EC2 instance?
questions.explanation: AWS CloudTrail records API calls, detailing which identity stopped, terminated, or modified an EC2 instance.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Storage.
questions.question: A Cloud Practitioner is required to retain data for seven years in order to comply with regulatory standards. Which AWS service meets this need for the LEAST amount of money?
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 Glacier provides durable, secure, and cost-effective long-term data archiving suitable for multi-year regulatory retention.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: Why is an AWS Well-Architected review a critical part of the cloud design process?
options: A Well-Architected review is mandatory before a workload can run on AWS.
A Well-Architected review helps identify design gaps and helps evaluate design decisions and related documents.
A Well-Architected review is an audit mechanism that is a part of requirements for service level agreements.
A Well-Architected review eliminates the need for ongoing auditing and compliance tests.
questions.correctAnswer: A Well-Architected review helps identify design gaps and helps evaluate design decisions and related documents.
correctAnswers: A Well-Architected review helps identify design gaps and helps evaluate design decisions and related documents.
questions.explanation: An AWS Well-Architected review evaluates architectures against cloud best practices to identify architectural gaps and improve efficiency.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: A company implements an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling policy along with an Application Load Balancer to automatically recover unhealthy applications that run on Amazon EC2 instances. Which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework does this action cover?
questions.explanation: Combining EC2 Auto Scaling with an Application Load Balancer supports the Reliability pillar by ensuring automated elasticity and fault recovery.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & Compliance.
questions.question: What does AWS's obligation under the shared responsibility paradigm entail?
options: Updating the network ACLs to block traffic to vulnerable ports.
Patching operating systems running on Amazon EC2 instances.
Updating the firmware on the underlying EC2 hosts.
Updating the security group rules to block traffic to the vulnerable ports.
questions.correctAnswer: Updating the firmware on the underlying EC2 hosts.
correctAnswers: Updating the firmware on the underlying EC2 hosts.
questions.explanation: Under the Shared Responsibility Model, AWS is responsible for updating firmware and hardware drivers on physical underlying EC2 hosts.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering DevOps & Automation.
questions.question: AWS CloudFormation is intended to assist the user in the following ways:
questions.explanation: AWS CloudFormation allows modeling and provisioning infrastructure resources systematically using Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: Which AWS Cloud benefit is shown by an architecture's ability to withstand failures with minimal downtime?
questions.explanation: High availability is the ability of an architecture to withstand component failures without experiencing service downtime.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Compute.
questions.question: Under the AWS shared responsibility model, which task is the customer's responsibility when managing AWS Lambda functions?
options: Scaling Lambda resources according to demand
questions.explanation: When using AWS Lambda, creating function versions and aliases and managing code releases are customer responsibilities.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Billing & Support.
questions.question: A company needs to generate reports that can break down cloud costs by product, by company-defined tags, and by hour, day, and month. Which AWS tool should the company use to meet these requirements?
options: Reserved Instance utilization and coverage reports
questions.explanation: AWS Cost and Usage Reports (CUR) provide comprehensive, granular breakdown of AWS costs and resource usage metadata.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & IAM.
questions.question: A business wishes to grant access to Amazon RDS to one of its workers. Additionally, the corporation wishes to confine contact to the AWS CLI and AWS software development kits (SDKs). Which combination of measures should the business do in order to satisfy these needs while adhering to the concept of least privilege? (Select two.)
options: Create an IAM user and provide AWS Management Console access only.
Create an IAM user and provide programmatic access only.
Create an IAM role and provide AWS Management Console access only.
Create an IAM policy with administrator access and attach it to the IAM user.
Create an IAM policy with Amazon RDS access and attach it to the IAM user.
questions.correctAnswer: Create an IAM user and provide AWS Management Console access only.
correctAnswers: Create an IAM user and provide AWS Management Console access only.
Create an IAM policy with Amazon RDS access and attach it to the IAM user.
questions.explanation: To grant console access with least privilege, create an IAM user with Management Console access and attach a scoped IAM policy for Amazon RDS.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Architecture.
questions.question: Which of the following guidelines constitutes a well-architected design philosophy for cloud application development?
options: Keep static data closer to compute resources.
Design for automated recovery from failure.
questions.correctAnswer: Design for automated recovery from failure.
correctAnswers: Design for automated recovery from failure.
questions.explanation: Designing for automated recovery from failure using health checks and auto scaling is a core Well-Architected principle for Reliability.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering DevOps & Automation.
questions.question: A company has a serverless application that includes an Amazon API Gateway function, and an Amazon DynamoDB database. Which AWS service can the company use to trace user requests as they pass through components?
questions.explanation: AWS X-Ray traces and analyzes requests flowing through serverless microservices including API Gateway, Lambda, and DynamoDB.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Databases.
questions.question: A company needs to set up a petabyte-scale data warehouse in the AWS Cloud. Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: Amazon Redshift is a fast, scalable, fully managed petabyte-scale data warehouse designed for complex analytical SQL queries.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cloud Foundations.
questions.question: What are the immediate advantages of AWS Cloud computing? (Select two.)
options: Capital expenses are replaced with variable expenses.
AWS holds responsibility for security in the cloud.
questions.correctAnswer: Capital expenses are replaced with variable expenses.
correctAnswers: Capital expenses are replaced with variable expenses.
questions.explanation: Immediate benefits include trading upfront capital expenses for variable operational costs and gaining rapid business agility.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cost & Optimization.
questions.question: The following are the economical advantages of using AWS: (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Economic benefits of AWS include lowering Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and reducing operational expenditures through managed efficiencies.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & IAM.
questions.question: Which AWS service is always provided at no charge?
questions.explanation: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) is a core security feature provided at no additional charge for all AWS accounts.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Security & IAM.
questions.question: Which acts exemplify excellent practices for AWS IAM use? (Select two.)
options: Share the security credentials among users of AWS accounts who are in the same Region
Use access keys to log in to the AWS Management Console
Rotate access keys on a regular basis
Avoid using IAM roles to delegate permissions
correctAnswers: Rotate access keys on a regular basis
questions.explanation: Best practices for IAM include configuring strong password policies and rotating access keys regularly.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering DevOps & Automation.
questions.question: A business wants to establish templates that it may reuse when deploying numerous AWS resources. Which Amazon Web Services (AWS) offering or functionality can the business employ to achieve this requirement?
questions.explanation: AWS CloudFormation provides declarative JSON/YAML templates that can be reused to deploy consistent infrastructure stacks across environments.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Cost & Optimization.
questions.question: How can a business use AWS to lower its Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)?
options: By having no responsibility for third-party license costs
questions.explanation: AWS lowers TCO by replacing large upfront capital expenditures (capex) with flexible, pay-as-you-go variable operational expenses.

questions.summary: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam practice question covering Networking.
questions.question: A business's website is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances. The firm must guarantee that the website is accessible to a worldwide audience and has a low latency for visitors. Which Amazon Web Services (AWS) offering should the business employ to achieve these requirements?
questions.explanation: Amazon CloudFront delivers web content with low latency to a global audience using its worldwide network of edge location caching servers.
